_population_note: Approximate (council area, mid-2020s). Not used in any published copy; replace with a cited figure before it is.
_coordinates_note: Approximate city centre (George Square). Replace with a verified point before any radius/geo query uses it (Ticketmaster GB, Met Office).
_status: SKELETON (Glasgow Phase 2, 2026-10-22): site-wide noindex ON, every data source and feature disabled. Nothing scrapes or publishes for this town yet. Phase 3 adds sources one by one, each behind its own enabled flag, after reachability and robots/ToS are verified.

ai.tone_guidelines: Plain, neutral, concrete. Explain what the council or committee is deciding or hearing, in everyday words. Facts from the source only.

identity._terms_note: ai_pipeline/town_guard.py cross-site contamination guard: terms a US town must never mention. Chosen to be unambiguous; display_name (Glasgow) and county (Glasgow City) are added automatically.

compliance._note: Scottish contempt-of-court rule (Phase 5): any item about arrests, charges, sheriff or High Court proceedings or named suspects is held, never auto-published.

city_meetings._notes: Phase 3.1 DONE 2026-10-22: CoInS (Northgate) via scrapers/parsers/glasgow_coins_v1.py. No robots.txt (404), no ToS found, no bot challenge on this host; www.glasgow.gov.uk is behind a Cloudflare challenge and is never touched. 49 meetings incl. 18 Area Partnerships + Licensing Board; agenda item titles only (papers are PDFs, not fetched). Personnel Appeals Committee (dismissal appeals) excluded. enabled:true only means the scraper CAN run: no scrape workflow/cron exists for glasgow yet and nothing has been written to the live DB.

weather._notes: Met Office DataHub Site Specific (Global Spot, free tier), MET_OFFICE_API_KEY, scrapers/parsers/met_office_site_specific_v1.py. 2 calls per run (hourly + daily). Writes the same weather_snapshots payload as NOAA, in degC and mph.

weather_alerts._notes: Met Office NSWWS (DataHub v1.1, MET_OFFICE_WARNINGS_API_KEY), scrapers/parsers/met_office_warnings_v1.py: a warning is stored only when the town point is inside its polygon. Served live by GET /api/weather-warnings (no rebuild). SEPA flood warnings are still to do.

traffic._notes: Phase 3.3: DATEX II needs an approved subscription; tellmescotland.gov.uk notices.

sources.name: glasgow_life
sources._note: Phase 3.4a, built 2026-10-22: Glasgow Life (council culture/libraries/sport trust) what's-on cards, scrapers/glasgow_life_events.py. robots.txt allows the paths, no bot challenge, no terms page found; listing pages (6 requests/day, 2 s apart) + since 2026-10-24 each distinct event page once a day (~40 requests, 2 s apart; description, tickets and age lines only) because the listing alone gave the writer nothing to summarise -- set detail_pages to false to stop; facts + link back, no images. About 41 distinct events (curated slice, no pagination). Dry-run verified; enabled 2026-10-22 after the owner approved the first events write.

events._notes: Ticketmaster GB is NOT a scraper source: it is fetched at build time by site/src/lib/ticketmaster.ts (latlong search, see site-config ticketmaster block) and is verified separately (phase 3.4b).

jobs._notes: Phase 3.6, verified 2026-10-22: the existing ADZUNA_APP_ID/ADZUNA_APP_KEY work for the gb endpoint (5 336 Glasgow results; dry run of the parser 50 rows, 46 with salary, 24 predicted = flagged est.). GBP, so the site renders pound signs for country gb (lib/jobs.ts) and the parser uses UK title keywords for gb only. One call/day (free tier). enabled 2026-10-22 after the owner approved the first jobs write; the jobs section is still in disabledSections for glasgow, so nothing is shown yet.

school_closures._notes: Phase 3.7: find a Glasgow City Council closure source or report that none exists.

food_hygiene._notes: Phase 3.8: Scotland uses FHIS Pass / Improvement Required, not FSA 0-5 stars.
